name: Kajiwara Kagetoki
source:
As a close adviser to Yoritomo, his relentless words and behaviors are feared by other samurai.

He is very competent at his job, but in his personal life, he is surprisingly bad at waking up early, tidying things up, and so on. Even hated by others, he still works as the shadow in the shogunate. It seems he has some kind of reason……?

Organization: Kamakura Bakufu
Interest: Knowledge-collection, practicing koto (he's bad at it)
